name: globe
summary: An interactive globe of land dots with markers and arcs for a list of places.
looks: A dark sphere in the box with the continents as dots (or a solid fill) and a thin glow along its rim. Each place is a marker on the surface; the one under the pointer or in focus grows and gets a ring. Arcs between places rise with their length and draw themselves along it once, or carry a dash that keeps running from the first place to the second. The globe turns slowly on its own, stops under the pointer and turns with a drag.
target: an element with a list of places inside, or an empty element with `markers` pointing at a list elsewhere

params.name: markers
params.description: Selector of the places: inside the element, or in the document when none are inside.

params.name: data
params.description: URL of JSON `{ markers: [{ id, lat, lng }], arcs: [{ from, to }] }`, added to the places.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude that faces the viewer; a change turns to it.

params.name: spin
params.description: Turns on its own around the poles; 0 stands still.

params.name: drag
params.description: Turn it by dragging, and with the arrow keys when it has a tabindex.

params.name: style
params.description: Land as dots, or as a solid fill of the land mask.

params.name: motion
params.description: How the arcs move: draw draws each arc once along its length, for offices and showrooms; flow runs a dash along each arc again and again, from the place that names it in data-dio-to to the other, for routes, deliveries and traffic.

params.name: dots
params.description: Dots over the whole sphere, about a third of them land up on land.

params.name: scale
params.description: Diameter as a fraction of the smaller side of the box.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the sphere, the ocean.

params.name: atmosphere
params.description: Color of the glow along the rim.

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the glow along the rim.

params.name: fps
params.description: Most frames a second while it spins on its own; dragging runs at full rate.

frames.note: While it spins or its arcs flow, at most `fps` frames a second; at full rate while dragged, coasting, turning to a place, drawing arcs or lighting a marker. None at rest without spin or flowing arcs, and none off screen.

reducedMotion.note: No spin, no coasting after a drag, arcs drawn whole at once without a flowing dash, and turns to a focused place made in one step. Dragging, arrow keys and lit markers still work: the visitor starts them.

presence.note: Leaves by dithering its pixels away while shrinking to 96%, so its opaque sphere never switches to transparent mid-transition.

touch: Nothing hovers: a tap on a marker works as a click. A finger turns the globe only when the element has `touch-action: pan-y` or `none`, otherwise the gesture scrolls the page.

notes.low: 4000 dots, spin at 20 frames a second.

cost.gpu: Five draw calls: the sphere, all land dots as one instanced call, all markers, all arcs and the glow.
cost.memory: About 12 bytes per land dot (40 KB at 12000 dots), or a 260 KB land mask texture for `solid`.

events.name: dio:marker
events.description: A marker lights up under the pointer, from a hovered legend item or a focused link, or goes dark (marker and id null). Bubbles; tooltips and the pointer cursor are up to the site.
events.detail: { marker: Element | null; id: string | null }
